name: load-slot-1-to-file-list
description: #38: from the title screen (boot point title-card) to the list of saves on the card in slot 1. Waits on the title overlay's menu mode g_MenuStartMode (7 title, 0 choose a card slot, 2/3 reading the card, 1 choose a file) and fade state g_TitleFadeState (1 = taking input), from Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/menu/title.c and config/symbols.savemenu.us.txt. The title cursor starts on Continue (TitleInit sets row 1), so Circle opens the slot choice, whose cursor starts on slot 1; Circle there reads the card. No press can reach New Game (that needs Down). Needs memory names title_mode and title_fade; its metric is w_files (frames until the file list shows), which the including scenario must list.
